modelDescription: An over and under for rugged environments. From the day the Cynergy was introduced, it was different. The ultra low-profile receiver and MonoLock Hinge design made it smaller, lighter and more nimble than other over and under shotguns — and the styling reflected the innovative qualities of the shotgun. Jump forward to today and we give you the Cynergy Wicked Wing, an over and under shotgun built to withstand virtually whatever comes its way.
